🔄 Content update (published August 7, 2026 / previously listed August 8, 2026)

Hanno City will sell three city-owned properties through general competitive bidding.

【Properties for Sale】
Property A (multiple parcels in Yamatechi, total farmland 242.24 sq m) — Minimum sale price ¥19.7 million, bid guarantee ¥2.955 million
Property B (Yamatechi 1406-3 and 1407-4, residential land 625.78 sq m) — Minimum sale price ¥46.9 million, bid guarantee ¥7.035 million
Property C (Yamatechi 1410-2, residential land 171.97 sq m) — Minimum sale price ¥18.4 million, bid guarantee ¥2.76 million
Bundle sale (Properties A, B, C combined 1,039.99 sq m) — Minimum sale price ¥68 million, bid guarantee ¥10.2 million

All properties are zoned as First Category Residential Area.

【Bidding Schedule】
Application period: August 21–September 3, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 9:00 AM–4:30 PM
Bidding date and time: September 11, 2026, 2:00 PM
Bidding venue: Hanno City Hall Main Building, 2nd Floor, Bidding Room

If bundle bids are received but no individual bids are submitted, the bundle bid takes priority. Application documents are available on the city's official website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/shisankeieika/shisannkeiei/7334.html
summary: ℹ️ City-owned land sale (general competitive bidding)
